verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API-driven card creation (paymentInstrument resource) and card updates via /paymentInstruments/{id}, including activate, suspend, close and relinking the balance account. Transaction rules give spend controls, and per-card balances plus payment webhooks exist, so an agent could drive the core of a card program through the API. However, transaction viewing is documented only in the Customer Area UI, there is no MCP surface or scoped-credential model in evidence, and no OpenAPI spec was found by the probe (an llms.txt does exist). Missing for 10: an MCP server, scoped/least-privilege API credentials, explicit API endpoints for reading balances and transactions, explicit API management of transaction rules, and independent corroboration of agent use.
